lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Hey there, Goku. How goes the recovery?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, the doctor said I should be in here for a couple of months; what with the crushed legs, shattered ribs... and the brain damage... and the brain damage ...and the brain damage.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh hey Master Roshi, when did you get here?

lines.speaker: Dr. Fieldgood
lines.text: You have another visitor to see you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: What? But... all my friends are already here.

lines.speaker: Young Goku
lines.text: Yay! I made it to the top!

lines.speaker: Young Goku
lines.text: Now I can train with Kami! The strongest, most powerful being on the...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: AAAAAH! AAAAH! GET HIM AWAY FROM ME!

lines.speaker: Dr. Fieldgood
lines.text: Well, we’ve finally been able to sedate him. Took us a while; we had to go through some alternative treatment.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Oh, really? What did you use?

lines.speaker: Dr. Fieldgood
lines.text: Something I found under the sink. I think it was... Clorox or something.

lines.speaker: Dr. Fieldgood
lines.text: Well, page me if you need me.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Oh, you’re still here.  Who are you anyway?

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: That’s Mr. Popo.  He lives up on the lookout with Kami.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Alright. Everyone listen up if you want to get those other useless maggots back.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You mean, you can get our friends back--?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: As I was saying, the only hope to get your friends back is to use the Dragon Balls on Kami’s home planet: Namek.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Namek?  That’s not a planet I’ve ever heard of.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Oh, look at that.  A woman who doesn’t know any better. What are the odds?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: To be fair, Mr. Popo, until recently I’ve never heard of that planet either.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Oh, look at that.  A woman who doesn’t know any better.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: AGA--d'aah! Dammit I walked right into that one.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Anyway, I’m the only one who knows where Kami’s old ship is, and the only one with the transportation to get you there; and this is a carpet made for two.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, I think the only way to fairly decide on this is to have a democratic vote.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: HA! We don’t need your help!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I’ve got right here a remote control to one of the crashed Saiyan ships. All I have to do is put in these coordinates and...

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Well, well, well.  Look who just ran out of options...

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Dammit, Bulma, stop being such a scaredy-cat and get on the carpet with the scary genie.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Ugh, I swear to God - if anything happens to me while I’m gone, I’m kicking Krillins’ ass.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Oh, you and I are gonna get along just fine.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Alright, here we are - Yunzabit Heights.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait a sec... how did we make it here so fast? This is the other side of the planet!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Yep, this carpet gets about ten thousand miles to the soul.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: But... if you can make it to the other side of the planet so fast, why didn’t you help Goku get to the Saiyans when he arrived on Earth?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Mr. Popo!  I need your carpet to get to my friends as quickly as possible!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It’s old and covered in moss!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: I know. Fits, doesn’t it? Now get in.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh wow!  Your name opens the ship?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: No. It just knows better. Welcome to Jupiter.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: My God! We’re so far into space! In such a short amount of time!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: This is wonderful, Mr. Popo! We can finally save our friends! This is terrific! This is--

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: And we went to Jupiter in just a couple of seconds! We’ll be at Namek in no time! And even better, Popo could be our pilot!

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: If I was going to do it myself, why would I need you?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: See you when you get back! Except... this season... you.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Heh... whaddya think he means by that? Heh.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Well, all I know is that my little boy isn’t going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, Mom... I’m going to Namek.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: As. I. Said. My little boy... isn't... going... *anywhere*!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But Mom! Piccolo died for me! It’s my responsibility!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Gohan, I am your mother! And as your mother, you will listen to me, and you will do as I say!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Did you carry around a baby in you for nine months, with a man who literally thought you had Cinna-Buns hidden in your shirt?!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Now you’re going to lay in this hospital bed, recover like a normal boy, and then you’re going right back to your Advanced Trig classes, AND THAT IS THE LAST WE WILL--!!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Uh well, uh... better get started on that ship!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: With that, Bulma got to work on the ship to prepare it for their travel.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hey Dad, how are things coming along?

lines.speaker: Dr. Briefs
lines.text: Well, I’m working on your translator, but all I can get it to do is translate the Namekian into another language I don’t understand.

lines.speaker: Toilet
lines.text: Toire de arimasu! (Japanese for “I am a toilet”)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And in ten days, the remaining warriors were recovered and ready to set out to Namek.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, you sure this thing’s ready to fly?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yep! I’ve gotten everything worked out. Well, except for one thing: We couldn’t fix the translator for the toilet...

lines.speaker: Toilet
lines.text: ICH BIN GEFÜLLT MIT PISSWASSER! (German for “I am filled with pee”)

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Hey, I think I see their car.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Gohan, how are yo--ooOOOH MY GOD!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What happened to your head? You look like a young Moe Howard!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Clam it, chowderheads, we gotta get going!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Now Gohan, don’t make any friends with any questionable strangers!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So Bulma, where do I put my stuff?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Sit down, strap in, and shut up!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So Gohan, how much stuff did you bring?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, Mom packed my bags, so there’s a lot in there.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, you know what they say: “Always be prepared”.

segments.title: And the Brain Damage
segments.quote: ...and the brain damage... and the brain damage ...and the brain damage. — Oh hey Master Roshi, when did you get here?

segments.title: Not *All* of Them
segments.quote: Not *all* of them. — AAAAAH! AAAAH! GET HIM AWAY FROM ME!

segments.title: Alternative Treatment
segments.quote: Something I found under the sink. I think it was... Clorox or something.

segments.title: Did That Cat Just Talk?
segments.quote: That’s Mr. Popo. He lives up on the lookout with Kami. — ...Did that cat just talk?

segments.title: A Woman Who Doesn’t Know Any Better
segments.quote: Oh, look at that. A woman who doesn’t know any better. What are the odds?

segments.title: The Democratic Vote
segments.quote: Bulma! — Bulma! — Bulma. — Bulma. — Bulma. — Yoooohooo! Bulma.

segments.title: Ten Thousand Miles to the Soul
segments.quote: Yep, this carpet gets about ten thousand miles to the soul. — What? — ...The gallon.

segments.title: POPO! (Welcome to Jupiter)
segments.quote: Oh wow! Your name opens the ship? — Popo! ... Welcome to Jupiter.

segments.title: Except... This Season... You
segments.quote: See you when you get back! Except... this season... you.

segments.title: SHUT YOUR F**KING FACE!
segments.quote: SHUT YOUR F**KING FACE!!!!! — ...I’ll be going to Namek now. — You best.

segments.title: Damn Moon-Speak
segments.quote: Toire de arimasu! (Japanese for “I am a toilet”) — Damn moon-speak! ... ICH BIN GEFÜLLT MIT PISSWASSER!
